# authwise_audiences (Data Source)

An API an issuer issues access tokens for, and the audience its Access catalog hangs off.

`status` is `active` (the default) or `disabled`: no token is issued for a disabled audience, refresh grants included. Changing it is made in place and keeps everything under it; kit 1.91.0 or later (the `identity.object-status` feature), and the administration tenant's own objects cannot be turned off. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `audiences` (Attributes List) Every audience under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audiences))

<a id="nestedatt--audiences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audiences`

Read-Only:

- `audience_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `status` (String)
- `theme_variant_id` (String)
